init.title: Event Recording Options
init.description:
Manage storage settings, recording concurrency, and optional camera recording defaults.

Known Limitations:
- Native lookback may reuse an active HLS buffer, but is best effort; cold streams may have no pre-roll. An external retained-video provider (for example Frigate) is optional.
- Snapshot mode captures still images only.
- Storage capacity admission failures return STORAGE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED; only writers unsettled after timeout or cancellation are quarantined.
- event.start_at is the logical requested-window start (occurred_at minus requested lookback), not intake time or verified image UTC.
- This integration serializes its own writers; unrelated camera.record callers can still collide.
- Storage-root migration UI and grouped-card timeline presentation are deferred.
